Findings.Detail: This machine is a different Windows host from the one in the repository records: a different user profile, no project working copy in Documents, no tool runtime cache in the profile. Its observations are a new candidate, not evidence for the previously recorded environment.

The candidate runtime is a per-user CPython install, not a tool-managed cache. NEWS.txt names 3.12.10 final, release date 2025-04-08. Runtime file modification times observed through the bridge all fall on 2025-04-08 UTC. Version comes from NEWS.txt text only; the interpreter was not run.

44 PE files hashed. All are x86-64 and carry an Authenticode blob (signature not verified). Imports resolve inside the runtime except 23 named system DLLs and 14 API-set names. One delay import exists: _wmi.pyd -> ole32.dll.

Read access to the system DLL folder was granted, but the file bridge refused every system DLL because each is hard-linked (component store). OS DLL bytes and SHA are not recorded. API-set names are not resolved to host DLLs.

From the harness and subject direct imports, the import-time closure (module bodies and class bodies, including top-level if/try branches; function bodies excluded) resolves to 68 Lib files, all hashed. 41 names are not Lib files; their dispositions are listed. Encodings loaded by name at run time are not statically resolvable.

Following every import statement including function bodies pulls in much of the standard library. The scan stopped with 102 modules resolved and 16 files still to read. This upper bound is not closed.

CPython 3.11 and later load some start-up modules (for example os, stat, ntpath, codecs, io, abc) from frozen copies inside python312.dll, so their Lib SHA is not the code that runs. Lib __pycache__ files observed were written 2026-10-30T21:03Z, so the Lib tree is writable by the user and holds bytecode the loader may prefer. Both limit check-to-use. The frozen list is CPython behaviour, not verified on this host.

Not obtainable with read-only file access and no execution: T0 pre-start verification, two-side call identity, check-to-use protection, OS DLL bytes. The harness and subject sources are not on this machine.

OD04Decision.Note: Candidate observation on a new host. Not admitted and not evidence for the recorded environment.
